title: The Throne in the Clouds
text: Above the sixth shrine a throne of storm sits empty but for the one on it. Lightning walks in his beard and the clouds kneel at his feet. He offers strength to anyone who will call him king. He asks only that you kneel, leaving a little of yourselves behind.

options.label: Kneel among the clouds and call him king, for strength like the storm's.

outcomes.text: The thunder flows into your arms. When you rise, something of each of you remains kneeling at his feet.

options.label: Refuse him under his own sky, and let the storm do its worst.

outcomes.text: He rises from his throne of storm with the lightning crackling eagerly about him.

options.label: Take the lightning and stay standing. A king who demands kneeling has not earned it.

outcomes.text: The Leader takes the lightning without kneeling. The Thunderer laughs, amused, as the clouds scatter from his feet.
He sees it coming. The lightning goes through the Leader's ribs instead; the smell of scorched flesh lingers for days.
